provenance.evidence: A Municipality of Prishtina publication places Sahat Kulla in Prishtina's historic centre, identifies it as an important utilitarian-architecture monument, and dates its construction to the nineteenth century. Kosovo ministry record8620 describes a hexagonal tower, lower stone and upper brick, small arched openings and roof. Original six-sided masonry form with dark time-display symbols; no invented analog hands or exact clock display. All dimensions, colours, simplifications and composition proportions are original art direction, not source measurements.
